desc: print comma-separated list of high bandwidth nodes. Note: This is EXPERIMENTAL API. The functionality and the header file itself can be changed (including non-backward compatible changes), or removed.
r:
memkind-hbw-nodes - print comma-separated list of high bandwidth nodes.
Note: This is EXPERIMENTAL API. The functionality and the header file itself can be changed (including non-backward compatible changes), or removed.
memkind-hbw-nodes prints a comma-separated list of high bandwidth NUMA nodes that can be used with the numactl --membind option.
memkind-hbw-nodes exits with status 0 on success, 1 on failure, 2 on invalid argument.
